Create Primary Entity

Start by creating the company that will own transactions.

No Primary Entity exists yet. Create the Primary Entity first so HRMS, ERP and future transactions have one company context to operate under.

This becomes the root company for legal, GST, location and transaction ownership.
The ERP Login Access step captures the Primary Admin name, phone number, User ID and password for this company context.
Franchisee entities and locations can be added under this primary setup later.
